source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Unit 10 (PDF 276-287), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 10 (Solution of Trigonometric Equations) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Which one of the following is a trigonometric equation?
(In mein se kaun si trigonometric equation (tikonmiyati muadla) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trigonometric equation mein koi trigonometric function hota hai. Sirf \(2\tan x - 1 = 0\) mein \(\tan x\) hai; baqi algebraic equations hain.

book_ref.quote: A trigonometric equation is an equation that involves one or more trigonometric functions

blocks.prompt:
2 The principal solutions of a trigonometric equation are the solutions that lie in the interval:
(Trigonometric equation ke principal solutions (bunyadi hal) kis interval (wqfa) mein hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke mutabiq jo solutions aik poore chakkar \([0, 2\pi]\) mein hon woh principal solutions kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: The solutions that lie within the interval \([0, 2\pi]\) are called the principal solutions.

blocks.prompt:
3 A trigonometric equation such as \(\sin x = \frac{1}{2}\) has infinitely many solutions because trigonometric functions are:
(\(\sin x = \frac{1}{2}\) jaisi trigonometric equation ke be-shumar solutions kyun hote hain? Kyunke trigonometric functions:)
blocks.explanation: Periodic function apni values dohrata hai: \(\sin x = \frac{1}{2}\) ke kisi solution mein \(2\pi\) jama karein to naya solution milta hai, aur yeh silsila chalta rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to the periodic nature of trigonometric functions, these equations have infinitely many solutions

blocks.prompt:
4 To write the general solution of \(\cot x = k\), the period added to a principal solution is:
(\(\cot x = k\) ka general solution (aam hal) likhne ke liye principal solution mein kaun sa period jama karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan\) aur \(\cot\) ka period \(\pi\) hai, is liye \(n\pi\) jama karte hain, \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: Period \(2\pi\) for \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\sec\), \(\csc\); period \(\pi\) for \(\tan\), \(\cot\)

blocks.prompt:
5 The reference angle used to solve \(\cos x = -\frac{1}{2}\) is:
(\(\cos x = -\frac{1}{2}\) hal karne ke liye reference angle (hawala zaviya) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reference angle positive value \(\frac{1}{2}\) se nikalta hai: \(\cos\alpha = \frac{1}{2} \Rightarrow \alpha = \frac{\pi}{3}\). Minus ka nishan sirf quadrants chunta hai.

book_ref.quote: Find the reference angle \(\alpha\) from the positive value

blocks.prompt:
6 If \(\cos x = k\) with \(-1 < k < 0\), then the principal solutions lie in the quadrants:
(Agar \(\cos x = k\) aur \(-1 < k < 0\) ho to principal solutions kin quadrants (rub) mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cosine sirf quadrant I aur IV mein positive hai, is liye negative cosine ke liye quadrant II ya III chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Since cosine is negative, \(x\) lies in the II and III quadrants with reference angle

blocks.prompt:
7 With reference angle \(\alpha\), the angle in quadrant III (in \([0, 2\pi]\)) is:
(Reference angle \(\alpha\) ho to quadrant III wala zaviya (\([0, 2\pi]\) mein) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quadrant I: \(\alpha\); II: \(\pi - \alpha\); III: \(\pi + \alpha\); IV: \(2\pi - \alpha\).

book_ref.quote: an angle in quadrant III is \(\pi + \alpha\) and an angle in quadrant IV is \(2\pi - \alpha\)

blocks.prompt:
8 The principal solutions of \(\cos x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) are:
(\(\cos x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) ke principal solutions kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\); cosine negative hai to II aur III: \(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{3\pi}{4}\), \(\pi + \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{5\pi}{4}\).

book_ref.quote: Reduce the equation to one or more basic equations

blocks.prompt:
9 The principal solutions of \(\sin x = \frac{1}{2}\) are:
(\(\sin x = \frac{1}{2}\) ke principal solutions kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\); sine positive hai to I aur II: \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) aur \(\pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6}\).

book_ref.quote: Use the sign of \(k\) to choose the two quadrants

blocks.prompt:
10 The principal solutions of \(\tan x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) are:
(\(\tan x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) ke principal solutions kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\); tangent negative hai to II aur IV: \(\frac{5\pi}{6}\) aur \(\frac{11\pi}{6}\).

book_ref.quote: Reference angle from the positive value, quadrants from the sign

blocks.prompt:
11 The general solution of \(\sin x = -1\) is:
(\(\sin x = -1\) ka general solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x = -1\) sirf \(x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\) par hai; period \(2\pi\). (\(\frac{3\pi}{2} + n\pi\) mein \(\frac{5\pi}{2}\) bhi aa jata hai jahan \(\sin x = 1\) hai.)

book_ref.quote: Special values with no quadrant pair

blocks.prompt:
12 The general solution of \(\cos x = 0\) is:
(\(\cos x = 0\) ka general solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = 0\) \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par hai, jin mein \(\pi\) ka faasla hai, is liye \(x = \frac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\).

book_ref.quote: Special values with no quadrant pair

blocks.prompt:
13 The general solution of \(\tan x = 1\) is:
(\(\tan x = 1\) ka general solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\) aur \(\tan\) ka period \(\pi\): \(x = \frac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\). (\(+2n\pi\) se \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) reh jata hai.)

book_ref.quote: Add the period: \(+2n\pi\) for \(\sin\), \(\cos\), \(\csc\), \(\sec\); \(+n\pi\) for \(\tan\), \(\cot\).

blocks.prompt:
14 The general solution of \(\sin x = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) is:
(\(\sin x = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) ka general solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Principal solutions \(\frac{\pi}{3}\) (I) aur \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\) (II); dono mein \(2n\pi\) jama karein. \(\frac{4\pi}{3}\) par sine negative hai.

book_ref.quote: Since \(2\pi\) is the period of \(\cos x\), so all possible solutions of

blocks.prompt:
15 The number of principal solutions of \(4\sin^{2}x = 1\) in \([0, 2\pi]\) is:
(\(4\sin^{2}x = 1\) ke \([0, 2\pi]\) mein kitne principal solutions hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x = \pm\frac{1}{2}\): \(+\) se \(\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}\) aur \(-\) se \(\frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}\): chaar solutions.

book_ref.quote: After \(\pm\) (square roots) solve both cases; the general solution is the union of all families.

blocks.prompt:
16 The general solution of \(\tan^{2}x = 3\) is:
(\(\tan^{2}x = 3\) ka general solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan x = \pm\sqrt{3}\). \(\sqrt{3}\) se \(\frac{\pi}{3} + n\pi\), \(-\sqrt{3}\) se \(\frac{2\pi}{3} + n\pi\). \(\pm\) chhorne se aadhe solutions zaya ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Dropping \(\pm\) when taking a square root

blocks.prompt:
17 The principal solutions of \(2\sin^{2}x - \sin x - 1 = 0\) are:
(\(2\sin^{2}x - \sin x - 1 = 0\) ke principal solutions kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: a product is zero only when one of its factors is zero

blocks.prompt:
18 The equation \(\cos x = 2\) has:
(Equation \(\cos x = 2\) ke kitne solutions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har \(x\) ke liye \(-1 \le \cos x \le 1\), is liye \(\cos x\) kabhi \(2\) nahin ho sakta.

book_ref.quote: every basic equation \(\sin x = k\) or \(\cos x = k\) with \(-1 < k < 1\)

blocks.prompt:
19 When both sides of a trigonometric equation are squared, the new equation may have:
(Trigonometric equation ke dono taraf square karne se nayi equation mein kya aa sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(A = B\) ko square karne se \(A = -B\) bhi hal ho jati hai, is liye extraneous roots (faltu jazar) aa sakte hain. Har root ko asal equation mein check karein.

book_ref.quote: Squaring can bring in extraneous roots

blocks.prompt:
20 If both sides of \(2\sin x\cos x = \sin x\) are divided by \(\sin x\), which solutions are lost?
(Agar \(2\sin x\cos x = \sin x\) ke dono taraf \(\sin x\) se taqseem karein to kaun se solutions zaya hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Factorise karein: \(\sin x(2\cos x - 1) = 0\). \(\sin x\) cancel karne se \(\sin x = 0\) wale solutions \(x = n\pi\) zaya ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: never cancel a factor that contains \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
21 Squaring \(\sin x + \cos x = 1\) gives the candidates \(0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\). Which of them are extraneous?
(\(\sin x + \cos x = 1\) ko square karne se candidates \(0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\) milte hain. In mein se extraneous kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Rakh kar dekhein: \(0, \frac{\pi}{2}, 2\pi\) par jama \(1\) hai; \(\pi\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par \(-1\). Is liye \(\pi\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) extraneous hain.

book_ref.quote: So every potential solution must be substituted back into the original equation before it is accepted.

blocks.prompt:
22 The principal solutions of \(\sec x = -2\) are:
(\(\sec x = -2\) ke principal solutions kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = -\frac{1}{2}\); reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{3}\); II aur III: \(\frac{2\pi}{3}\), \(\frac{4\pi}{3}\).

book_ref.quote: the reference angle always comes from the positive value

blocks.prompt:
23 The general solution of \(\cot x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) is:
(\(\cot x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) ka general solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan x = \sqrt{3}\) se \(x = \frac{\pi}{3}\); \(\cot\) ka period \(\pi\), is liye \(x = \frac{\pi}{3} + n\pi\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).

book_ref.quote: Note that \(\cot x\) and \(\csc x\) need \(\sin x \ne 0\).

blocks.prompt:
24 The general solution of \(\cos 2x = \frac{1}{2}\) is:
(\(\cos 2x = \frac{1}{2}\) ka general solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle \(2x\) nikalein: \(2x = \frac{\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\) ya \(\frac{5\pi}{3} + 2n\pi\). Phir sab ko 2 se taqseem karein: \(x = \frac{\pi}{6} + n\pi\) ya \(\frac{5\pi}{6} + n\pi\).

book_ref.quote: Halving too early: solve for \(2\theta\) first, then divide by 2.

blocks.prompt:
25 The principal solutions of \(2\cos^{2}x - \cos x - 1 = 0\) are:
(\(2\cos^{2}x - \cos x - 1 = 0\) ke principal solutions kya hain?)

book_ref.quote: a product is zero only when one of its factors is zero

blocks.prompt:
26 Which of the following is NOT a solution of \(\cos x = \frac{1}{2}\)?
(In mein se kaun sa \(\cos x = \frac{1}{2}\) ka solution NAHIN hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos\frac{2\pi}{3} = -\frac{1}{2}\). Baqi \(\frac{\pi}{3} + 2\pi\), \(\frac{5\pi}{3} - 2\pi\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{3}\) hain, sab general solution mein shamil.

book_ref.quote: Meaning of \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)

blocks.prompt:
27 To solve \(f(x) = g(x)\) graphically, the solutions are read as:
(\(f(x) = g(x)\) ko graph se hal karte waqt solutions kya parhe jate hain?)

options.text: dono graphs ke sab se oonche points

blocks.explanation: Crossing \((a, b)\) dono graphs par hai, is liye \(f(a) = g(a)\): solution us ka \(x\)-coordinate \(a\) hai.

book_ref.quote: The \(x\)-coordinates of these intersection points are the solutions that satisfy \(f(x) = g(x)\).

blocks.prompt:
28 An equation such as \(\cos x = \frac{x}{3}\), which cannot be solved by identities, is called:
(\(\cos x = \frac{x}{3}\) jaisi equation jo identities se hal na ho, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein \(\cos x\) aur algebraic \(\frac{x}{3}\) mile hue hain; koi identity \(x\) ko alag nahin kar sakti. Aisi equations transcendental kehlati hain aur graph se hal hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: (Such equations are called transcendental equations.)

blocks.prompt:
29 All real solutions of \(\cos x = \frac{x}{5}\) lie in the interval:
(\(\cos x = \frac{x}{5}\) ke tamam real solutions kis interval mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(-1 \le \cos x \le 1\) se \(-1 \le \frac{x}{5} \le 1\), yani \(-5 \le x \le 5\).

book_ref.quote: If no interval is given, use the range of the trigonometric side

blocks.prompt:
30 When \(\sin x = \frac{x}{4}\) is solved graphically, \(x\) must be measured in:
(\(\sin x = \frac{x}{4}\) ko graph se hal karte waqt \(x\) kis unit mein napa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x\) sine ke bahar \(\frac{x}{4}\) mein bhi hai, is liye woh real number hona chahiye: zaviya radians mein napte hain.

book_ref.quote: Always measure \(x\) in radians

blocks.prompt:
31 The number of real solutions of \(\sin x = \frac{x}{4}\) is:
(\(\sin x = \frac{x}{4}\) ke kitne real solutions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Solutions \([-4, 4]\) mein hain. Line \(x = 0\) par aur \((\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi)\) mein aik dafa wave ko kaatti hai; symmetry se aik aur: \(x \approx 0, \pm 2.47\), yani 3.

book_ref.quote: This graphical approach not only helps in determining the number of solutions

blocks.prompt:
32 For \(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\): at \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(\sin x - \frac{x}{3} > 0\) and at \(x = \pi\), \(\sin x - \frac{x}{3} < 0\). Hence a root lies:
(\(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) ke liye \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\sin x - \frac{x}{3} > 0\) aur \(x = \pi\) par \(< 0\) hai. Is liye root kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x - \frac{x}{3}\) ka nishan badalna matlab graphs beech mein kat rahe hain. (Root \(x \approx 2.279\).)

book_ref.quote: To improve a reading, use the sign test

blocks.prompt:
33 If \(x = a\) is a solution of \(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\), then another solution is:
(Agar \(x = a\), \(\sin x = \frac{x}{3}\) ka solution ho to aik aur solution kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin x\) aur \(\frac{x}{3}\) dono odd hain: \(\sin(-a) = -\sin a = -\frac{a}{3}\), is liye \(-a\) bhi solution hai.

book_ref.quote: both functions are odd, so a root at \(a\) gives a root at \(-a\)

blocks.prompt:
34 The vertical asymptotes of \(y = \tan x\) are at:
(\(y = \tan x\) ke vertical asymptotes kahan hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\) wahan undefined hai jahan \(\cos x = 0\): \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke taaq multiples par.

book_ref.quote: Remember that \(\tan x\) is not defined at odd multiples of \(\frac{\pi}{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
35 The values of \(y = 3\sin x + 1\) lie between:
(\(y = 3\sin x + 1\) ki values kin hadood ke darmiyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(3\sin x\) \(-3\) aur \(3\) ke darmiyan; \(1\) jama karne se \(-2\) aur \(4\) ke darmiyan.

book_ref.quote: the number in front stretches the wave vertically (amplitude)

blocks.prompt:
36 At \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\) the values of \(f(x) - g(x)\) are \(2, -1, -3, 1, 2\). The least number of solutions of \(f(x) = g(x)\) in \([0, 2\pi]\) is:
(\(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, \frac{3\pi}{2}, 2\pi\) par \(f(x) - g(x)\) ki values \(2, -1, -3, 1, 2\) hain. \([0, 2\pi]\) mein \(f(x) = g(x)\) ke kam az kam kitne solutions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nishan \(0\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke darmiyan aur \(\pi\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) ke darmiyan badalta hai: do tabdeeliyan, yani kam az kam do crossings.

book_ref.quote: each change of order means one crossing

blocks.prompt:
37 The solutions read from a graph are usually:
(Graph se parhe gaye solutions aam tor par kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Graph se taqreeban aik do decimal tak durust jawab milta hai; har value dono taraf rakh kar check karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Graphical answers are approximate; check each one by substituting in both sides.

blocks.prompt:
38 Which one of these equations needs the graphical method?
(In mein se kis equation ke liye graphical method chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf \(\cos x = \frac{x}{3}\) mein \(x\) trigonometric function ke andar aur bahar dono jagah hai; baqi basic equations ban jati hain.

book_ref.quote: No identity can bring \(x\) out of the sine and also keep it outside

blocks.prompt:
39 The number of real solutions of \(\sin x = 2x\) is:
(\(\sin x = 2x\) ke kitne real solutions hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 0\) solution hai. \(x \ne 0\) ke liye \(|\sin x| < |x| < |2x|\), is liye line wave ko sirf origin par milti hai.

book_ref.quote: the line is outside \([-1, 1]\) where \(\sin x\) lives

blocks.prompt:
40 In the interval \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), the number of solutions of \(\tan x = \frac{x}{3}\) is:
(\(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) mein \(\tan x = \frac{x}{3}\) ke kitne solutions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani branch par dono graphs \((0, 0)\) se guzarte hain; \(0 < x < \frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\tan x > x > \frac{x}{3}\) (aur \(x < 0\) par iska aks), is liye sirf \(x = 0\).

book_ref.quote: so its graph comes in separate branches.

blocks.prompt:
41 From a point 40 m from the foot of a tower on level ground, the angle of elevation of its top is \(60^{\circ}\). The height of the tower is:
(Hamwar zameen par minar ke qadam se 40 m door aik nuqte se us ki choti ka angle of elevation (bulandi ka zaviya) \(60^{\circ}\) hai. Minar ki oonchai kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan 60^{\circ} = \frac{h}{40}\), is liye \(h = 40\sqrt{3} \approx 69.28\) m.

book_ref.quote: In each right triangle write

blocks.prompt:
42 A pole 30 m high is observed from a point 30 m from its foot on level ground. The angle of elevation of its top is:
(30 m ooncha khamba us ke qadam se 30 m door hamwar zameen se dekha jata hai. Choti ka angle of elevation kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: an angle at the observer is \(\tan^{-1}\frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\)

blocks.prompt:
43 For positive \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\), \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta\) equals:
(Positive \(\alpha\) aur \(\beta\) ke liye \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh unit ka difference formula hai: \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta = \tan^{-1}\frac{\alpha - \beta}{1 + \alpha\beta}\).

book_ref.quote: turns the difference into one inverse tangent

blocks.prompt:
44 \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2} - \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) equals:
(\(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{2} - \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{3}\) kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{3}}{1 + \frac{1}{6}} = \frac{1}{7}\). (\(\tan^{-1}1\) jama ka jawab hai, farq ka nahin.)

book_ref.quote: Using \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta = \tan^{-1}\frac{\alpha - \beta}{1 + \alpha\beta}\)

blocks.prompt:
45 A statue of height \(s\) stands on a pillar of height \(p\). At a point on the ground at distance \(d\) from the foot of the pillar, the statue subtends the angle:
(\(s\) oonchai ka mujassama \(p\) oonche sutoon par hai. Sutoon ke qadam se \(d\) door zameen par nuqte par mujassama kitna zaviya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Choti tak line \(\tan^{-1}\frac{p + s}{d}\) aur mujasme ke neeche tak line \(\tan^{-1}\frac{p}{d}\) ka zaviya banati hai; mujassama in dono ke darmiyan nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The angle an object subtends (between the lines to its bottom and its top) is a difference of two such angles.

blocks.prompt:
46 For the range \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\), the launch angle that gives the greatest range is:
(Range \(R = \frac{v_0^{2}}{g}\sin 2\theta\) ke liye sab se zyada range kis launch angle par hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 2\theta\) sab se bara (\(= 1\)) tab hota hai jab \(2\theta = 90^{\circ}\), yani \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\).

book_ref.quote: The range is maximized when \(\sin 2\theta\) is maximized.

blocks.prompt:
47 A ball is projected with \(v_0 = 14\) m/s (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). Its maximum range is:
(Gaind \(v_0 = 14\) m/s se phenki jati hai (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). Us ki maximum range kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: is largest at \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\)

blocks.prompt:
48 A launch angle of \(25^{\circ}\) gives a certain range. The other launch angle giving the same range (same speed) is:
(\(25^{\circ}\) ka launch angle aik range deta hai. Usi speed par wohi range dene wala doosra angle kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin 2(90^{\circ} - \theta) = \sin 2\theta\), is liye \(90^{\circ} - 25^{\circ} = 65^{\circ}\).

book_ref.quote: Complementary launch angles always give the same range

blocks.prompt:
49 With \(v_0 = 14\) m/s and \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\), the launch angles that give a range of 10 m are:
(\(v_0 = 14\) m/s aur \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\) ke saath 10 m range dene wale launch angles kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(10 = 20\sin 2\theta\), \(\sin 2\theta = \frac{1}{2}\), \(2\theta = 30^{\circ}\) ya \(150^{\circ}\), is liye \(\theta = 15^{\circ}\) ya \(75^{\circ}\).

book_ref.quote: gives two launch angles that add to \(90^{\circ}\)

blocks.prompt:
50 The height \(h\) (in m) of a cliff satisfies \(h^{2} + 10h - 2000 = 0\). The height is:
(Cliff (chattan) ki oonchai \(h\) (m mein) \(h^{2} + 10h - 2000 = 0\) ko poora karti hai. Oonchai kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: \((h - 40)(h + 50) = 0\), \(h = 40\) ya \(-50\). Oonchai positive hoti hai, is liye \(h = 40\) m.

book_ref.quote: Keeping the negative root of the quadratic: a height is positive.
